title: Tip from Angela - Use Accountability in your Favour
summary: A motivation tip: announce your learning goals to other people so social accountability helps you stick with them.

concepts.heading: Accountability tip
points: Goals known only to you are easy to drop; telling others adds a social cost to quitting.
Make the intention concrete and public, for example a fixed daily time commitment over a set number of days, with regular progress check-ins.
Social platforms host an established community around this: the #100DaysOfCode and #codingnewbie hashtags, where learners log daily progress and encourage each other.
Benefits: a visible track record of what was done each day, plus encouragement from people going through the same thing.
Action: post your goal and begin logging progress using those hashtags.
